name: Ezer
title: Son of Seir the Horite
summary: Ezer was one of the sons of Seir the Horite, who lived in the land of Edom (Seir) before the descendants of Esau took over the area. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as one of the original clan leaders in the region of Seir.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as a son of Seir
keyEvents.description: Eser is listed as one of the sons of Seir the Horite, the original inhabitants of the land of Se'ir.

keyEvents.title: Eser's sons mentioned
keyEvents.description: Eser's sons Bilhan, Saavan, and Akan are listed as clan leaders in the region of Se'ir.

keyEvents.title: Eser as a tribal chief
keyEvents.description: Eser is mentioned as one of the Horite tribal chiefs in the land of Se'ir, showing his leading position among the Horites.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Eser's lineage is repeated in 1 Chronicles as part of the extensive genealogical record of the people of Edom.
